title: IRGC claims it destroyed Amazon's Bahrain data center
summary: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) has claimed responsibility for destroying Amazon's data center in Bahrain, representing a significant escalation in cyber and physical attacks on cloud infrastructure in the Middle East region.
problem_solved: This is a news report about a geopolitical/security incident, not a solution-oriented technical article.
why_valuable: Provides awareness about potential threats to critical cloud infrastructure and the evolving nature of cyber warfare targeting tech companies.
